justification: Stacked on the verify-script versioning (#845): council attribution now prefers the dcp_precinct_boundaries.former_council column over PRECINCT_ID_PATTERNS regexes. The pattern approach degrades per council: dotted Parramatta ids (7.10.1, 9) and name-keyed Woollahra ids (Paddington HCA) have no safe regex, and unmatched ids fall through to the Marrickville default (the #835/#842 bug class). Column set on all new boundary rows (Parramatta-staged 13, Woollahra-staged 14); patterns stay as fallback for legacy NULL rows (Ku-ring-gai). Also adds 9 KNOWN_POINTS (4 Parramatta + 5 Woollahra, SIX-geocoded, all verified against staged polygons) and 2 centroid exceptions (7.10.1 union of 2 disjoint HCAs; 7.10.12 = 5 parcels).

pre_impl.existing_data: Script existed since the 2026-07-28 Waverley session but scripts/ is gitignored wholesale; exceptions pattern already used for pr_overlap_guard, xref_*, hub_scrapers. CoS coords geocoded independently via SIX Address_Location (not derived from the polygons being tested); '60 Martin Place' omitted because SIX returns the 53-63 odd-side range.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If SIX coords were wrong the new spot checks would fail loudly, not pass silently; all three verified passing against production before commit.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Additive only: 3 KNOWN_POINTS entries, 1 CENTROID_EXCEPTIONS entry, 2 comment lines, 1 gitignore exception. No logic changes.

functions.name: normalizeFormerCouncil
functions.input: stored former_council value (display name, slug, NULL, blank)
functions.output: display form (city_of_sydney -> City of Sydney, ku_ring_gai -> Ku-ring-gai) or null
functions.if_none: null/undefined/blank return null so the caller falls back to patterns

functions.name: resolveFormerCouncil
functions.output: column-first attribution; getFormerCouncilFromPrecinctId only when column NULL
functions.if_none: both empty -> patterns -> Unknown/Marrickville default unchanged (legacy behaviour)

values.value: KNOWN_POINTS grows 11 -> 20 (4 Parramatta + 5 Woollahra SIX-geocoded entries)
values.if_missing: spot checks silently skip new councils and a bad boundary reload passes verification

values.value: CENTROID_EXCEPTIONS grows 8 -> 10 (7.10.1 union of 2 disjoint HCAs; 7.10.12 five parcels)
values.if_missing: script reports 2 permanent warnings and PASS-with-warnings becomes noise

queries.purpose: multi-match precinct lookup now also reads council attribution from the row
queries.where_clause: ST_Contains(boundary, point) AND LOWER(lga)=LOWER($3) — unchanged; only former_council added to SELECT

queries.purpose: nearest-precinct fallback reads the same column
queries.where_clause: LOWER(lga)=LOWER($3) AND ST_DWithin(...500m) — unchanged; only former_council added to SELECT

break_it.scenario: The CoS boundaries are later reloaded with shifted geometries (e.g. wrong SRID) and the reload forgets to re-verify.
break_it.what_happens: The three CoS spot checks fail with exit code 1 the next time the script runs - which is the point of versioning it.
break_it.how: Script is now tracked and referenced from the boundary worklist doc as the mandatory pre/post-import check.
break_it.repro: Shift any CoS boundary by 0.01 deg and run the script.

break_it.scenario: A clone without .env runs the script.
break_it.what_happens: Pre-existing behaviour: KeyError on SUPABASE_DB_URL - unchanged by this PR, config comes from repo-root .env.
break_it.how: Out of scope; documented in the script docstring usage.

break_it.scenario: A future council loads boundary rows whose former_council holds an unknown slug (e.g. northern_beaches).
break_it.what_happens: normalizeFormerCouncil title-cases it (Northern Beaches) instead of silently attributing Marrickville.
break_it.how: Generic slug title-casing with joiner-word handling; jest cases pin the known values.

break_it.scenario: Column set to whitespace-only by a bad loader.
break_it.what_happens: Treated as NULL -> pattern fallback, never a blank display string.
break_it.how: normalizeFormerCouncil trims and returns null on blank; test pins it.

break_it.scenario: The multi-match precinct lookup query runs against a database whose dcp_precinct_boundaries lacks the former_council column (stale environment).
break_it.what_happens: The SELECT errors, the existing catch returns null and the address gets no precinct match — visible as a missing-precinct result, never a wrong-council attribution.
break_it.how: Column has existed on the production table since the Inner West loads; the catch block already downgrades any query error to a null match, and the nearest-precinct fallback query fails the same visible way.
break_it.repro: Drop former_council in a scratch DB and call getPrecinctForAddress.

post_merge.secrets: None - script reads DATABASE_URL from .env, no values committed.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run python scripts/verify_precinct_boundaries.py — expect PASS 20/20 spot checks, 0 warnings. After deploy: flip Parramatta-staged -> City of Parramatta (portal LGA Name string), re-run script; Woollahra flip waits for provision keying.
